goal: Limit each Organization's request rate through Valkey and restore in-process load shedding, both as middleware on the Effect HttpApi server.
preserved_behavior: For requests that are neither rate limited nor shed, status codes, bodies and the Location/retry-after headers are unchanged
Requests without a valid token still get 401 from Authentication and consume no rate-limit token
The balance-monitor job store keeps its current Redis options, and the raw ioredis error stays as RedisError.cause (Effect's NOSCRIPT recovery depends on it)
Route tests and the test environment run without Valkey, and nothing is shed when environment is test or test-*

tasks.name: RateLimit middleware module
inputs: design.md: Rate limiting section and US-1 to US-4
apps/api/src/auth.ts: Authentication provides CurrentToken (OrgToken with organizationId)
apps/api/src/lib/errors.ts: TooManyRequestsError and TooManyRequestsApiError encode the 429 body and retry-after header
effect/unstable/persistence RateLimiter: consume fails with RateLimiterError whose reason is RateLimitExceeded or RateLimitStoreError; layerStoreMemory
tasks.description: Create RateLimit, an HttpApiMiddleware.Service that requires CurrentToken and declares TooManyRequestsApiError, and makeRateLimitLayer({ limit, window }) that builds its layer from RateLimiter. For each request consume one token keyed by the token's organizationId with the fixed-window algorithm and onExceeded fail. On success run the handler and set x-ratelimit-limit, x-ratelimit-remaining and x-ratelimit-reset (durations rounded up to whole seconds) on the response. Branch on error.reason._tag: RateLimitExceeded fails with TooManyRequestsError (retryable, retryAfterSeconds rounded up, at least 1); RateLimitStoreError runs the handler unchanged and logs only when fail-open starts and when it recovers. Do not wire it into the server in this task so the existing suites and typecheck stay green. Add a lib-ratelimit element for src/lib/RateLimit.ts to .oxlintrc.json, allowed to import auth, lib-contract and lib-errors.

new_abstractions.name: RateLimit / makeRateLimitLayer
new_abstractions.requirement: Per-Organization limiting after authentication (US-1 to US-4)

tests: With limit 2 and a window of about 200 ms, the third request from one Organization gets 429 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS with retryable true and retry-after of at least 1
A second Organization still gets 200 while the first is limited
The first Organization succeeds again after waiting out its refill time
200 responses carry x-ratelimit-limit, x-ratelimit-remaining and x-ratelimit-reset
A store that always fails with RateLimitStoreError gives 200 without rate-limit headers and logs one warning per outage
A request without a token gets 401 and does not consume a token
acceptance: The middleware branches on reason._tag, not on the outer error
Nothing in server.ts, api.ts or runtime.ts changes

tasks.name: Pure pressure sampling
inputs: design.md: Load shedding section and US-5
Old @fastify/under-pressure thresholds: event-loop delay 1000 ms, heap 500 MB, RSS 1 GB; delay is the histogram mean minus the timer resolution, NaN means blocked
tasks.description: Create LoadShedding.ts with the threshold constants and a pure sample(histogramMeanNs, resolutionMs, memoryUsage) that returns whether the process is overloaded: delay (mean minus resolution) above 1000 ms, NaN delay, heap used above 500 MB, or RSS above 1 GB. Do not include an event-loop-utilisation check. Add a lib-loadshedding element for src/lib/LoadShedding.ts to .oxlintrc.json, allowing only what it imports (if it renders HTTP responses it also needs an entry in the boundaries/external HTTP allow list).

tests: Table test at each threshold: just under is not overloaded, just over is overloaded, for delay, heap and RSS

tasks.name: Shed load at the edge
inputs: design.md: Load shedding wiring bullet and US-5

apps/api/src/server.ts: EdgeMiddleware is HttpRouter.middleware(Effect.succeed(...), { global: true }) with the chain logger(connectionClose(bodyLimit(edgeErrors(httpEffect)))); problemResponse renders an HttpError with retry-after
tasks.description: Add shedLoad(verdict)(httpEffect), which returns problemResponse(new ServiceUnavailableError('Service under pressure', { retryable: true, retryAfterSeconds: 50 })) without running the handler when the verdict says overloaded, and a scoped startSampler that enables monitorEventLoopDelay, forks a 1 s Schedule.spaced sampler writing the latest sample result to a Ref, and disables the histogram on scope close. Change EdgeMiddleware's construction effect to read ServerConfigTag: in test or test-* environments the verdict is always not overloaded, otherwise it comes from startSampler. Insert shedLoad inside edgeErrors so the chain is logger(connectionClose(bodyLimit(edgeErrors(shedLoad(verdict)(httpEffect))))). Do not add a per-request service lookup. Export or move problemResponse only if LoadShedding.ts needs it. Allow lib-loadshedding (and lib-errors if needed) in the server boundaries rule in .oxlintrc.json. If LoadShedding.ts imports HTTP transport packages, add lib-loadshedding to the boundaries/external HTTP allow list too, and do not import problemResponse from server.ts (that would create a lib to server cycle); export or move it instead.
